8.note: Emptied in adjudication. The reader keyed "." and asked for a human check; at 4x the mark is a small comma-shaped ink blob to the right of "sacrificed.", with no letterform, and the ALTO box is 14x41 px — too tall and narrow for a period. Keying it "." would put a character the page does not set into gt/ocr/. Left as an empty line rather than deleted, since the geometry is the segmenter's record of what it found and only text is a reading. Note the batch was inconsistent here: 2-031 met the same class twice (its lines 8 and 38) and dropped the speck from within the line, which is the same ruling reached a different way. Worth confirming the empty line survives restore as intended.
